description: Retrieve context BEFORE answering. Searches SharedMemory for relevant memories using semantic similarity. Returns matching memories from vector search + related knowledge graph facts.

agent_id.description: Filter results from a specific agent

app_id.description: Filter results from a specific app

date_from.description: Filter memories with event_date >= this ISO date (e.g. 2026-04-01)

date_to.description: Filter memories with event_date <= this ISO date (e.g. 2026-04-30)

query.description: What to search for in memory

rerank.description: Re-rank results for better relevance. Default: false

session_id.description: Filter results to a specific session

user_id.description: Filter results to a specific user

volume_id.description: Volume ID. Uses default if not set.

name: query
